name: Chasing Death keeps Deathchaser on a target below 20% health for its 5-second window (#972)
contract: Chasing Death 707455 (Reaper Soul talent, CharacterAdvancement 6709) reads: Deathchaser used against a target below 20% health will now reapply itself at the end of its duration until they die or until $807418d (5 sec, SpellDuration 28) passes. Every Deathchaser rank (805190 and its spell_ranks chain up to 573053, SpellFamilyName 36, SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x4) repeats the clause.

Spell.dbc: 707455 is a single SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL effect with TriggerSpell 807418 and ProcFlags 0. 807418 (Chasing Death, Extender Aura) is an enemy-target aura with TargetAuraState 2 (below 20% health), 5000 ms duration and SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL every 499 ms into 807546, which is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION on Deathchaser 805190 with value 1001, also TargetAuraState 2. Deathchaser itself lasts 1000 ms (SpellDuration 36) and ticks every 250 ms, four ticks without the talent.

Expected: after a landed Deathchaser on a target below 20% health the extender aura is on the target, Deathchaser is still present and still ticking well after its 1-second duration, and it is gone within about one Deathchaser duration after the 5-second window. On a target above 20% health nothing changes: no extender aura and Deathchaser ends after its four ticks. The same holds for the level-60 rank 573053.
Deathchaser 805190 is DmgClass 2 (melee), so the Reaper gets melee hit and expertise rating so the application roll cannot miss or be dodged; Soul Infusion 803031 is its CasterAuraSpell.
